context_requirements: Functional GABA-A receptor expression (neuronal lineage) for central benzodiazepine effects; absent in these nine non-neuronal lines
TSPO expression for peripheral benzodiazepine effects; present in some lines but activation alone does not drive a robust transcriptional program at 6-24 h
Mitochondrial permeability transition pore competence for TSPO-agonist-induced apoptosis, which is cell-type-specific and not expected broadly
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of a coherent GABAergic or TSPO-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h in any of the nine lines
Consistent concentration-dependent changes in apoptosis or mitochondrial genes across multiple lines at 24 h
Shared differentially expressed landmark genes across lines that are not explained by generic stress or proliferation

evidence.supports: TSPO agonist PK11195 induces apoptosis in insulinoma cells via mitochondrial permeability transition, a cell-type-specific effect
Peripheral benzodiazepine receptor agonist Ro-54864 modulates IGF-IR/mTOR/AKT signaling in human chondrocytes, indicating context-dependent transcriptional effects
PK11195-induced retinal ganglion cell death is cell-type-specific and not blocked by cyclosporin A, showing limited generalizability
